name: Select Vendor for Bill On Popover Open
purpose: Popover open handler for the Bill vendor picker: clears the vendor filter, puts the cursor in the filter field and refreshes the vendor portal.

name: Select Vendor for Bill On Popover Close
purpose: Popover close handler for the Bill vendor picker: clears the vendor filter, puts the cursor in the filter field and refreshes the vendor portal.

name: Select Vendor for Bill: Filter
purpose: Type-ahead filter for the vendor picker: remembers the cursor position, moves to the vendor portal so the portal refreshes with the current filter text, then returns to the filter field and restores the cursor.
open_question: The filter itself is applied by the portal relationship on GLOBAL::FILTER, not in this script.

name: Select Vendor for Bill
purpose: Selects a vendor for the current Bill by copying the chosen vendor id into Bill::id_Vendor and closing the popover.

name: Add Vendor From Bill
purpose: Adds a new vendor from the Bill screen: if the filter text is blank it focuses the new-vendor-name field; otherwise it clears the Bill vendor link, commits to break the old link, and sets the display name of the (new, related) vendor to the filter text.
writes:
Bill::id_Vendor#6 (step 4, current record, cleared)
Bill_Vendor::displayName#15 (step 7, related via Bill_Vendor, can create the related vendor)
open_question: Relies on cascadeCreate through Bill_Vendor to create the vendor; vendor sync to QBO happens in the sync engine, not here.

name: Bill OnCommit Trigger
purpose: Bill commit trigger: flags the Bill for sending to QuickBooks (qbo_send = True), summarizes line totals into subtotal and taxable subtotal, and sets totalAmt = subtotal + totalTax + shipAmt. The automatic tax calculation from the tax code percentage is disabled.
writes:
Bill::qbo_send#10 (step 3, current record)
Bill::subtotal#43 (step 8, current record)
Bill::taxableSubtotal#41 (step 9, current record)
Bill::totalAmt#30 (step 16, current record)
open_question: Tax calculation (steps 10-15) is disabled, so totalTax is user-entered. Triggered on commit of a Bill; confirm the trigger attachment.

name: New Bill for ( id_Vendor )
purpose: Opens the Bill desktop layout with a new Bill for the given vendor id (new record, sets Bill::id_Vendor). The iPad, iPhone and line-item branches are disabled.
open_question: 18 of 27 steps are disabled legacy (copied from the Invoice version). The new record is created in the current window with no commit.

name: BillItem Amount OnObjectExit Trigger
purpose: Bill line amount trigger: rounds the line amount to 2 decimals, and when the unit price times quantity (default 1) rounded to 2 does not equal the amount, recomputes unitPrice = amount / qty to 7 decimals. Branches on the line DetailType parameter (ItemBasedExpenseType vs account-based).
writes:
BillLine_ItemBasedExpenseType::amount#21 (step 9, current record)
BillLine_ItemBasedExpenseType::unitPrice#23 (step 18, current record)
BillLine_AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail::amount#21 (step 23, current record)
BillLine_ItemBasedExpenseType::unitPrice#23 (step 32, current record, in the account-based branch)
open_question: Step 32 writes the ItemBasedExpenseType unitPrice from the AccountBased branch (target table occurrence differs from the one read in steps 25-31); likely a copy error. Purpose line: same auto-calculations as the QuickBooks UI.
